name: 33-hono-cookie-max-age-const
title: Extract the 400-day cookie lifetime limit into a constant
body: The Max-Age and Expires checks in _serialize each hard-coded the 400-day limit. Define it once as MAX_COOKIE_AGE_SECONDS and use it in both places.

bugs.why: The Expires difference is in milliseconds but is compared against a limit in seconds, so any Expires more than ~9.6 hours ahead throws.
